SELECT 'dupkey' k, count(*) n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_content', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, product_key, sale_ts_utc, quantity, gross_amount FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_overlap', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_in_fact', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)
UNION ALL SELECT 'closures', count(*) FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL SELECT 'nullstore', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND store_key NOT IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store)

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) g, sum(net_amount) net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.channel_code='ST'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT receipt_id, line_no, sale_ts_utc, product_key, quantity, gross_amount, sales_line_id, store_key FROM fact_sales_line WHERE receipt_id IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY receipt_id, product_key, sale_ts_utc, quantity, gross_amount HAVING count(*)>1 LIMIT 4) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no

WITH f AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) net_nostaff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.channel_code='ST' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) m, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(units_sold) u, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores, min(store_id) mi, max(store_id) ma FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT * FROM f JOIN r USING (m) ORDER BY m

SELECT d.is_trading_day, d.is_public_holiday, d.holiday_name, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) g, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_date_diff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.channel_code='ST' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
